banner_backend_down: Cannot reach the server. Opening your map, searching, and downloading maps will not work until it is back.
err_address_no_location: That address does not correspond to any location. About 35% of word combinations do not, which is what makes a typo obvious.
err_address_part_count: expected 3 words and a number, got {count} parts
err_core_failed: Something inside Tessarium failed, which is a fault here and not something you did: {detail}
err_insecure_context: This page is not in a secure context, so it will not derive a key. Serve it over HTTPS or from localhost.
err_locked: The key is locked. Enter your seed phrase again to unlock it.
err_mnemonic_checksum: checksum failed -- likely a typo in one word
err_mnemonic_word_count: expected 24 words, got {count}. 12-word phrases are not accepted: 128 bits of entropy is only 64 against a quantum adversary.
err_passphrase_too_long: passphrase too long: {bytes} bytes NFKD-normalised, the limit is 1000
err_point_out_of_range: that point is outside the mapped range
gate_deriving_hint: Argon2id over 64 MB of memory. Slow on purpose, and only once per session.
gate_fineprint: 24 words only. A 12-word phrase carries 128 bits of entropy, which Grover's algorithm reduces to an effective 64. Your phrase is never stored, never put in the URL, and never sent anywhere — the key is derived here, in a worker, on this device.
gate_generate_hint: The button draws 24 words from your device's cryptographic random source: 256 bits of randomness, beyond any search.
gate_lede: Three words and a number address every ~3 m square on Earth, under a map that belongs to your seed phrase alone.
gate_passphrase_empty: Leave it empty if you are unsure. Empty is normal.
gate_passphrase_exact: You have to type it exactly the same way every time. Capital letters and spaces count. Change one character and you land on a completely different map rather than a slightly different one — that is the point of it, and also the danger. Nothing can recover it for you.
gate_passphrase_what: An extra secret of your own choosing — a word, a sentence, anything you like. It is not more words from the list above, and it is not a second seed phrase. Your 24 words and this together decide which map you get.
gate_phrase_placeholder: abandon ability able about above absent…
gate_phrase_warning_body: The checks here confirm you typed a phrase correctly, not that it was generated. A phrase can satisfy every one of them and still be easy to guess, and that is the one weakness no work elsewhere repairs. Type your own words only if this button produced them, and only if they protect nothing else.
gate_wordlist_note: The 24 words come from the standard English BIP-39 list, in every language this app speaks.
gate_write_down_body: They are the only way back to this map, and nothing here keeps a copy. Close this tab without writing them down and every address under them is gone for good.
gate_write_down_title: Write these 24 words down now, on paper.
lock_body: The key is forgotten straight away, and the map closes. Nothing you have downloaded is deleted.
lock_warning_body: They were never stored here, so there is nothing to recover them from. If they are not written down somewhere safe, cancel and do that first.
lock_warning_title: You will need your 24 words to get back in.
map_basemap_missing: No basemap found. Addressing still works over blank space; you can download maps for the area in view.
map_browse_hint: When on, areas you look at while online are saved and stay usable offline. Turning it off stops the fetching and clears recently browsed areas.
map_browse_toggle: Fill in the map while browsing online
map_coverage_gap: Detail here is not downloaded. The grid and addresses still work.
map_download_clamped: Too large for full street-level detail in one download: {names}. Pick states, provinces, or cities there instead.
map_download_covered: You already have the maps for this view.
map_download_depth_hint: This area is too large for full detail in one download, so it stops at regional detail. Zoom in, or pick a state or province, for street level.
map_download_estimate: About {size} of map data for this view.
map_download_estimating: Checking how much there is to fetch…
map_download_none: The map source has nothing for this area.
map_download_region_label: Or pick countries, states, or cities
map_download_world_add: Add the whole world at country level — about {size}. Flying anywhere shows a map right away.
map_download_world_estimate: Start with the whole world at country level — about {size}.
map_export_hint: Exported maps wait here until you save or delete them. Copy them to a machine with no internet and add them there.
map_import_hint: Choose a map file exported from another Tessarium, from a USB stick or anywhere else. Nothing is downloaded.
map_keyboard_hint: Arrow keys move the map, + and − zoom, Enter takes the address of the center square.
map_label: Map. Use the arrow keys to move, plus and minus to zoom, and Enter to take the address of the center square.
map_ledger_overview: {size} — the base map every region is drawn on
map_removed_none: Map removed from the list. Its tiles are shared with other downloads and stay.
map_too_many_squares: Too many squares in view to draw them all — zoom in
map_zoom_for_grid: Zoom in to see the grid
panel_coords_copy_failed: Could not reach the clipboard. Reveal the coordinates to select them by hand.
panel_copy_failed: Could not reach the clipboard. The address is on screen and can be selected.
panel_footer: Addresses are meaningless to anyone with a different seed phrase. The same square has an entirely unrelated address under every other phrase.
panel_no_selection: Tap or click any square on the map to see its address.
panel_phrase_note: Your 24 words are not stored here. Locking, or reloading the page, means typing them in again — this app cannot show them to you.
search_address_local: Addresses are resolved on this device. Only place names are looked up.
search_address_partial: This looks like an address, so it is not being searched for.
search_label: Search for a place, or enter an address
search_none: Nothing found in your downloaded maps
search_placeholder: A place, or an address like dream.tourist.creek.2703
search_prefix_hint: Four-letter prefixes work, and separators are forgiving: {example} resolves the same way.
